products.name: Newsboy Mini-Expansion
products.abstract: Follow the Gang Wars campaign before launch to get the Newsboy Pack for free and save €12. The pack includes 1 Newsboy miniature, which replaces the basic turn marker token, plus 2 exclusive News Cards that add more variety to your games.
products.description: The Newsboy Pack will be added at checkout for all backers who followed the campaign before launch. This add-on is multilingual.

products.name: Gang Wars - Basic Pledge
products.abstract: This reward contains the core game for Gang Wars and its Solo mode. The pledge will include all reveals for the core game we present during the campaign. You can choose the language of your game when adding it to your pledge.

products.name: Gang Wars (Core Game)
products.abstract: Take control of a criminal gang and fight for the streets of Prohibition-era Chicago. This add-on includes only the Gang Wars Core Game.

products.name: City of Violence Expansion
products.abstract: Bring more muscle to the streets with Street Bosses and Fixers, introducing new miniatures, abilities, strategic options, and ways to fight for control of Chicago.

products.name: Gangland Empire Expansion
products.abstract: Expand your criminal empire with spectacular oversized miniatures of iconic Chicago buildings, transforming the city skyline and bringing new strategic possibilities to your games.

products.name: Boss Ring Mini-Expansion
products.abstract: Show everyone who’s the Boss with a full-size wearable Boss Ring, replacing the cardboard Starting Player token. Also includes 1 exclusive Associate card and 1 exclusive Job card.

products.name: Big Truck
products.abstract: Add some serious presence to your table with this massive, highly detailed PVC truck, scaled to your Gang Wars miniatures and designed to hold your Barrel tokens.

products.name: Deluxification Set
products.abstract: Give your criminal empire the deluxe treatment with 50 pre-painted Barrels, 110 Money tokens, 12 acrylic Gang Power tokens, and 2 Associate Tier tokens.

products.name: Art Book
products.abstract: Explore the art of Gang Wars with this 120-page book and celebrate the talented human artists whose creativity and craftsmanship brought its characters, streets and stories to life.

products.name: Neoprene Playmat
products.abstract: Replace the standard Gang Wars game board with its premium neoprene counterpart, offering a soft, durable surface and a premium feel on your table.

products.name: Sleeves Pack
products.abstract: Protect ALL your Gang Wars cards! This pack includes 450 crystal-clear sleeves, enough for every card in the Core Game, expansions and add-ons. Made from 100-micron, 100% acid-free polypropylene.

products.name: Scarface 1920 + The Enforcers (Reprint)
products.abstract: Core Scarface 1920 and The Enforcers expansion. This edition is the same that was published in Kickstarter 4 years ago, and includes the same add-ons and Exclusives. You can choose the language version of the game.

products.name: Red Dragons Tong Gang (Reprint)
products.abstract: Red Dragons Tong adds a new gang to the fight for Chicago. Led by Charlie Gong, the opium kings will use their strong distribution networks to take control of the streets. If you lose sight of them for even a second, it will already be too late.

products.name: The Golden Oaks Gang (Reprint)
products.abstract: The Golden Oaks, led by Rocco & Bessie, have crossed the border from Canada to bring their own whisky to Chicago. Don't be fooled by their appearance: they won't hesitate to stain their elegant suits with blood to control the city.

products.name: Bloody Business (Reprint)
products.abstract: Bloody Business expansion for Scarface 1920, including all is Gamefound Exclusives. You can choose the language version of the expansion after adding it to your pledge.

products.name: Gangland Grooves Vinyl Disc
products.abstract: LAST UNITS LEFT! It's jazz night in Chicago. It's time for some Bloody Business! And what's the best way to do it? Yes, with friends. But also with a good background soundtrack, such as... the official Limited Edition Scarface 1920 soundtrack!

products.name: Paperboy Mini-Expansion
products.abstract: Lovely miniature that replaces the time marker token in the game. This charming young man carries with him three exclusive News cards, based on real news stories from the period and which have a direct impact on the game. Multi-language add-on.

products.name: Melvin Purvis Mini-Expansion
products.abstract: Melvin Purvis miniature to replace the G-Men token from the Bloody Business expansion. The pack includes 3 exclusive G-Men cards.

products.name: Night Deck Mini-Expansion
products.abstract: Ultra-premium deck of 83 alternative Associate cards, each featuring new skills and mechanics. Every card has been completely redesigned and printed with metallic inks for a stunning collector’s edition look. Even the box itself is a piece of art.

products.name: Expansions Box Storage Solution
products.abstract: The Expansions Box storage solution is an 18 cm tall box, with a premium design in Night Deck style (black and gold with an emboss effect), to storage all expansions and addons. It does NOT include the expansions or addons for which it is designed.

products.name: Gang Wars - Mobster Pledge
products.abstract: This reward contains the core game for Gang Wars and its Solo mode, as well as the City of Violence and Gangland Empire expansions. The pledge will include all reveals for the core game we present during the campaign.

products.name: Gang Wars - Big Boss Pledge
products.abstract: This reward contains Gang Wars, its Solo mode, the City of Violence and Gangland Empire expansions, as well as the Sleeves Pack for the whole pledge and the premium Neoprene Playmat.

products.name: Gang Wars - Empire Pledge
products.abstract: This reward contains Gang Wars, its Solo mode, the City of Violence and Gangland Empire expansions, the Sleeves Pack, Neoprene Playmat, as well as the Deluxification Set, the Big Truck and the Gang Wars Art Book.

products.name: Scarface 1920 Gameplay Bundle
products.abstract: This bundle contains the core Scarface 1920 and all its expansions: The Enforcers expansion, Bloody Business expansion and the 2 new gangs. You can choose the language version of all the products.

products.name: Scarface 1920 Expansions Bundle
products.abstract: This bundle includes the Bloody Business expansion and the two additional gangs. The gangs are both playable with the original Scarface 1920 as well as with Bloody Business. You can choose the language version of all three products.

products.name: Scarface 1920 Legacy All-in (Prepacked)
products.abstract: This Legacy All-in Bundle includes every item ever released for the Scarface 1920 Core Game, in a conveniently prepacked format: Core game, all expansions, all mini-expansions and all add-ons ever released.

products.name: The Enforcers (Reprint)
products.abstract: The first expansion for Scarface 1920 adds more depth to the multiplayer mode and important new features to the solo mode. It includes three new characters: Alina Ivankova, Tom Lee and "Raven" Kwiatkowski.

products.name: Solo Mode - Extra set of cards
products.abstract: Additional deck of Solo mode cards. This deck is not needed to play the game and its Solo mode. The extra deck of Solo cards has been made available for those willing to play with more than one solo mode deck.

products.name: Wooden Boxes
products.abstract: You asked for them to be back, and they are back. Set of two wooden boxes with lids, similar to those used during the Prohibition era, to store alcohol (Brown) and weapons (Green). The boxes feature the Scarface 1920 logo on one side.

products.name: Scarface 1920 Art Book
products.abstract: Scarface 1920 shines with its impressive art and illustrations. Enjoy this beautiful 120-pages art book with some of the best pieces created by Antonio Stappaerts for the game, and even some exclusive ones that you won't find anywhere else.

products.name: Bloody Business Deluxification Set
products.abstract: The Deluxification Set replaces the cardboard pieces with new plastic ones. Includes 42 bullets, 6 districts, 30 votes, and 40 money tokens (comprising 18 $2, 18 $20, and 4 $100 denominations).

products.name: Pre-painted Goods
products.abstract: Extra set of hand-painted high quality plastic goods: alcohol barrels and guns. It includes 50 barrels of alcohol and 35 guns. You can use this set to replace the original goods with this luxified version, or combine them to double the amount.

products.name: Plastic Business Markers
products.abstract: The most popular add-on from the Scarface 1920 campaign is more useful than ever with the Bloody Business Business track mechanic. Each pack contains 40 high-quality plastic markers: 10 speakeasies, 10 brothels, 10 casinos and 10 nightclubs.

products.name: Plastic Money Tokens
products.abstract: Money plays a pivotal role in the battle for Chicago. Purchase these high quality plastic money tokens in a bank robber style cloth bag to enhance the Scarface 1920 experience or for use in other board games.

products.name: Scarface 1920 Sleeves Pack
products.abstract: Premium Quality sleeves from SleeveKings. The pack includes sleeves for ALL the cards in the core Scarface 1920, The Enforcers and some more. All sleeves will be crystal clear transparent and 100 microns thick, made with 100% acid free polypropylene.

products.name: Bloody Business Sleeves Pack
products.abstract: Premium Quality sleeves from SleeveKings. The pack includes sleeves for ALL the cards in Bloody Business, new gangs and the Night Deck. . All sleeves will be crystal clear transparent and 100 microns thick, made with 100% acid free polypropylene.

products.name: Bloody Business Annex Playmat
products.abstract: 30x60cm. The smallest playmat in the family is designed to be placed besides the original playmat.

products.name: Scarface 1920 Original Playmat
products.abstract: 90x60cm. For all those who missed out on buying the original playmat in the previous campaign, it is now available again. Like its siblings, it is made of neoprene with stitched borders.

products.name: XL Playmat
products.abstract: 120x60cm. The largest playmat in the family is a single game board that includes both the core game board and the Bloody Business board, all in one neoprene with stitched borders.

products.name: Smaller Playmat
products.abstract: This alternative board combines Scarface 1920 and Bloody Business boards in a redesigned playmat 30% smaller than the original. This playmat is specially useful for smaller tables or for not so crowded games, like Solo mode or 2 players. (106x46cm).

products.name: Safe Boxes (6-pack)
products.abstract: This add-on contains 6 highly detailed Safe miniatures, each with a unique design inspired by 1920s Chicago. They replace the standard player screens, allowing you to store your money safely during the game.

products.name: Safe Boxes (2-pack)
products.abstract: This add-on contains 2 highly detailed Safe miniatures, designed for the Chinese and Canadian gangs in Scarface 1920. They replace the standard player screens, allowing you to store and conceal your money safely during the game.

products.name: Safe Boxes (4-pack)
products.abstract: This add-on contains 4 highly detailed Safe miniatures. They replace the standard player screens, allowing you to store and conceal your money safely during the game.

products.name: Gang Wars Solo Mode (extra set)
products.abstract: Add an extra player to your games! This additional set allows you to play against multiple automated opponents. Important: Every Gang Wars pledge already includes a Solo Mode set. Only purchase this Add-on if you want more sets.
